# kay

> kay is a Bun web framework. A `.kay` file is one component: TypeScript fences, then a pug-like indented template. Pages render to HTML on the server, islands run on kay's own signals and DOM runtime, and an Elysia plugin serves it all. Everything is typed, templates included, and `kay check` reports errors at the `.kay` line.

## Rules that are easy to get wrong

- Every dynamic value sits in `{}`: `a(href={url})`, `p Hello {name}`. A static attribute value is a quoted string: `a(href="/about")`.
- A signal or memo is read by calling it, `count()`, in the template and the script; a bare name in the template is the error `uncalled-signal`, fixed by `kay check --fix`. Assigning writes it: `count = 0`, `count += step`, `count++`. Props and server data are plain values: `{title}`, not `{title()}`; a child writing its parent's state types the prop `Bindable<T>` and assigns it, the parent passing `bind:open={open}`.
- A `for` matches its rows across renders by `item.id`, else by the item itself; `for post of posts key={post.slug}` names another key.
- An `await` block streams any promise: `await comments`, `await data.comments`, a prop or one a component makes.
- Shared values are exported from a `--- module` fence.
- A page has no props: its data comes from its `--- server` fence.
- Browser globals (`window`, `document`) are read in `effect`, `onMount` or a `--- client` component; reading one while rendering throws on the server.
- Every duration is a string with its unit, `'250ms'`, `'5m'` or `'30d'`; a bare number is a type error; `durationMs` gives milliseconds.
- Indentation is spaces only, consistent within a block. Text after a tag needs one space: `p Hello`, never `p:Hello`.
- `kay dev` writes the server errors to `.kay/dev/errors.json`: read it.
- Pug features that do not exist, each reported with a replacement: `- code`, `#{}`, `!{}`, `+mixins`, `include`, `extends`, `block`, filters, `&attributes`, `case`, `each`, `while`, `unless`, `doctype`.

## Libraries

Each library ships its `llms.txt` and `llms/`: open the one a task needs.

- [kayjs-auth](packages/auth/llms.txt): sign-in with OAuth, passwords, magic links, two-factor and passkeys
- [kayjs-ui](packages/ui/llms.txt): components styled by one theme: dialogs, toasts, tables, forms, charts
- [kayjs-mail](packages/mail/llms.txt): mails written as `.kay` components, SMTP from the environment, queued sending
- [kayjs-cms](packages/cms/llms.txt): content edited on the page it renders, collections, history, uploads
- [kayjs-ai](packages/ai/llms.txt): `ask()` over Anthropic or an OpenAI-compatible server, streamed replies, tools, limits

To build a site, read [Build a site](llms/site.md) first, then the topics below; `kay docs <words>` prints the matching section.
